QuestInfo.name: Dangerous City
QuestInfo.0: A man named Ryden in front of the Thieves' Hideout in Kerning City called out to you.
QuestInfo.1: Ryden asks you a bunch of questions about the Dark Lord. When he realizes you don't know a whole lot, he sends you off to see JM From tha Streetz.
QuestInfo.2: You went to see JM From tha Streetz as Ryden told you.

0.0: Hey there, kid! Yeah, I'm talking to you! Don't look so scared. I'm one of the good guys, okay? I need you to answer some questions.\r\n#L0##bUm... Okay.#l\n#k
0.1: You were just with the Dark Lord, weren't you? He tell you about himself? Like, about the history of Kerning City or the last Dark Lord or anything like that?\r\n#L0##bNope. I don't know anything about him. There was another Dark Lord before him?#l\n#k
0.2: Dang. No, I guess he wouldn't tell a rookie like you anything...\r\n#L0##bWhat's this about, anyway?#l\n#k
0.3: Don't worry your little head about it. Say, if you're looking for work, I think #p1052002# down below needs some help.

no.0: It's just some innocent questions. Nothing shady, I promise!
